messages:
anya: Final sanity check for Thursday's announce. Need: prod changelog anchor, CDN hero + compact images, sales webhook auth, and announce timing locked.

sophie: On changelog. Will merge tonight and flip docs to prod tomorrow AM. I'll post the exact anchor when live (aiming for /release/2026-03-26#rollout-fallback).

rachel: For webinar CTA we want a short link: https://redwood.ai/register?src=announce. Can marketing confirm UTM params so Sales can tie leads back?

marco: Ops: sales hook accepts HMAC X-Sales-Signature. I'll run a test POST at T-1h and confirm logs. Deploy window still 09:50 PT canary, 10:00 PT full.

anya: UTM: utm_campaign=announce-2026-03-26&utm_medium=email&utm_variant=A (A/B). Add ?src=announce to the CTA. Rachel, that works?

rachel: Perfect. Also uploaded CDN images: hero wide https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/launch/hero-26mar.png and compact https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/launch/bench-26mar-compact.png (alt text noted in asset manager).

sophie: Changelog short for social: "Launch: faster, cheaper inference 1 tuned batching, graceful quantized fallback, streaming stability fixes." Use that for tweets. Full technical notes in docs anchor.

marco: Healthcheck endpoint /v1/announce/health will be polled at T-2m and T+1m. Rollback policy: revert canary if 5xx > 1% over 2m. Sales webhook handshake test at T-1h returned 200 and signature verified.

ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled deploys: canary 6177777800, full 6177777900. Healthcheck snapshot (T-30m): 200 OK, p95 39ms.

anya: Two small asks before I lock the final post: 1) Sophie paste final prod anchor URL here; 2) Marco confirm sales webhook will include routing metadata for lead assignment.

sophie: Done. Prod anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-26#rollout-fallbacks

marco: Confirmed. The sales webhook response includes route:{sales-enterprise|saas-growth|nurture} based on company_size and employee_count. Logs show mapping test passed.

anya: Great. Locking announce at 09:55 PT, webinar email at 10:00 PT. I'll post final copy + links in #marketing-announce at T-10m. Please react with :thumbsup: if you are good.

sophie: :thumbsup:

rachel: :thumbsup: I'll monitor registration numbers and report CTR.

marco: :thumbsup: watching ops channel for rollouts.

anya: Thanks team 1 closing loop and prepping final publish bundle.
